facts.fact: The government, through the Universal Access Fund with the telecom ministry and the LTA, announced on 5 May 2025 a project to restore rural mobile sites, after an assessment found nine of twelve UAF-funded towers inactive for almost two years; restoration starts in Bomi, Gbarpolu and Grand Cape Mount.

LBR.note: No budget amount or levy stated; the UAF's income and spending are not given.
No African body or agreement named.
The 7.6% rural access figure is a GOGLA report's, not the World Bank series the study uses.
